description: Mortality Over Regions and Time (MORT) books is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Institute of Health and Welfare (AIHW). Mortality Over Regions and Time (MORT) books are Excel (XLSX) workbooks that contain recent mortality data (2016-2020) for specific geographical areas of Australia, sourced from the AIHW National Mortality Database. The workbooks also present the leading 20 causes of death by sex for specific geographical areas of Australia. MORT books are also available as online, interactive data visualisations. Coverage is Australia, 2016 to 2020; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as non-current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
